The transparent material used to make windows is glass.

Regarding the email, the original tone is somewhat blunt and could be perceived as dismissive. To better suit a professional audience and maintain a positive employer brand, the tone should be adjusted to be more empathetic, respectful, and encouraging. Here is the revised version:

Subject: Update on Your Application for the Marketing Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the marketing position and for sharing your qualifications with us. We truly appreciate the effort you put into your application.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with our current needs. Please know that this decision was not a reflection of your skills or potential, as we were impressed by your background.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page for future opportunities that may be a better match. We wish you the very best in your job search and professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
